{{quote| I'll see them safe if I have to stuff them into barrels and haul them to Caemlyn in a cart.| [[Mat]]'s thoughts on [[Elayne]], [[Nynaeve]], [[Aviendha]] and [[Birgitte]]}}

{{summary | book=7 |
|chapter=14
|title=White Plumes
|icon=Dice
|setting=[[Ebou Dar]] and the [[Silver Circuit]]
}}

{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}

Mat is at the [[Silver Circuit]] to watch the horse races. Mat has [[Nalesean Aldiaya]] put all his money on [[Wind (horse)|Wind]], which is ridden by [[Olver]]. Nalesean hands the booker several bags of gold. [[Juilin Sandar]] arrives and tells Mat that the girls hired a boat and [[Thom]] hired another to see where they go. Mat scans the crowd and one woman catches his attention, but he's not sure why. Finally he remembers her as [[Mili Skane|a woman who tried to kill him]] when he and Rand were making their way to [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|1|33}} Wind wins the race, which allows Nalesean to collect a large chest of gold while Mat heads out to follow the woman. She stops at a goldsmith's shop so Mat turns in to a ring seller. Mat is encouraged to try on a ring and when the woman starts moving again, the ring won't come off. Mat has to pay and shoves a bunch of coins at the merchant. As he leaves, the ring slips off his finger. She finally enters a small palace and when Mat mutters about who lives there, [[Jain Charin|a scrawny white-haired fellow]] nearby says, "[[Chelsaine Palace]] is let to [[Jaichim Carridin|Carridin]]". As Mat ponders the information he now has, the dice start tumbling in his head again.
